dispositions.name: glibc
dispositions.reason: CVE-2016-20013: authentication uses Keycloak JWT/PKCE, not glibc sha256crypt/sha512crypt passwords. CVE-2026-18374: user input is not supplied to an fopen mode/ccs extension; uploads store byte arrays in PostgreSQL. CVE-2026-8674: declared Channel dns_search=[.] (inherited by Test Support/isolated CI) disables host/VPN search domains; controlled Docker probe confirms DnsSearch=[.] and no long search entry. CVE-2026-89092: nscd is not installed/started by product. CVE-2026-86805/-95818: java and fixed curl healthcheck are non-setuid, and app does not invoke any setuid/setgid process or user-controlled loader path. CVE-2026-97399 is Power8-specific; this image is amd64. This is API-specific analysis, not a claim that glibc is unused. CVE-2026-84243 requires attacker-controlled LANGUAGE plus a crafted filesystem .mo catalogue. The declared runtime does not import LANGUAGE from requests/host environment; uploads stay in PostgreSQL and cannot install catalogues. That defect is not declared fixed upstream.

dispositions.name: expat
dispositions.reason: The four findings affect native libexpat XML processing (32-bit reallocation, malformed XML, or XML_ParseBuffer misuse). This service uses JSON and stores upload bytes; it has no native XML/JNI parser, image/font processing, or command launcher. Its explicit PDF constructors emit ASCII objects/Courier references and do not read fonts. Java/JAXB parsers, if present in dependencies, are not native Expat. The previously unknown CVE-2026-77214 was resolved against upstream PR1393: caller-supplied buffer length exceeds XML_ParseBuffer capacity; no such caller exists in this product. The four additional records require native XML_ParserReset accounting, DTD entity amplification, chunked external entities or oversized attribute counts in libexpat. Actual JRE ELF dependencies have no libexpat, the app has no JNI/process parser and uploads remain uninterpreted PostgreSQL bytes. Native Expat parsing is absent, not Java XML processing in general.

dispositions.name: gnutls28
dispositions.reason: These five findings require GnuTLS X.509 certificate verification. Exact JRE ELF dependency inspection has no GnuTLS dependency; current Java HTTP clients and application code have no GnuTLS JNI/process entry point. Its only product health command is the fixed plaintext HTTP localhost:8080/actuator/health request, not LDAP/TLS/certificate processing. Vendor dispute/deferred status is not treated as a fix; native severities and failure remain. CVE-2026-88648 additionally requires GnuTLS msUPN/SRV certificate name-constraint verification; the same actual JRE/JSSE versus fixed plaintext curl boundary excludes it. The vendor dispute and deferred status are not treated as a patch.
